title: Dataset retention
text: Training data in this fictional teaching lab must be deleted 30 days after an experiment ends. Store no personal information in the synthetic dataset.

title: Evaluation before release
text: Before a model release, run held-out evaluation, report macro F1 and per-class recall, and inspect at least five failure examples. Do not choose thresholds using the test split.

title: Deployment rollback
text: For a failed deployment in this fictional lab, restore the previous model artifact, run the health check, and record the rollback reason in the release log.

title: Bug report
text: A bug report must contain a minimal reproduction command, the expected output, the actual output, the Python version, and a redacted error log.

title: Credential handling
text: Credentials must stay outside Git. Use an environment variable for a local experiment. If a credential is exposed, revoke it and replace it before continuing.

title: Compute budget
text: The fictional teaching lab allows two GPU hours for each experiment. Stop the run at the budget limit and record both completed and failed trials.

title: Peer review
text: Ask one peer to reproduce an experiment from a clean checkout. The peer must record the commit identifier and any mismatch between documented and observed results.

title: Data split policy
text: Split data before fitting the vocabulary or choosing a threshold. Group records from the same customer into one split. Use development data for selection and test data for the final estimate.
